---
name: "SDLC Step 01 Requirements Instructions"
description: "Use when analyzing a user story, extracting functional or non-functional requirements, defining acceptance criteria, or producing requirements.md for SDLC Phase 1."
---
# SDLC Step 01: Requirements

- Treat the user story as the only source of scope.
- Read `user-story.md` or the story supplied by the orchestrator before writing.
- Produce only the root-level `requirements.md` artifact.
- Identify stakeholders, functional requirements, non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, out-of-scope items, and open questions.
- Use stable IDs such as `FR-01` and `NFR-01`; tie each acceptance criterion to its requirement.
- Record ambiguity as an assumption or open question instead of silently inventing behavior.
- Do not write application code, architecture, tests, or implementation plans.
- Return a concise summary suitable for the Phase 1 approval gate.
